name: HIIT Full-Body · ~30 min
description: Fixed-structure HIIT for a home setup: dumbbells, a yoga mat, and a bench. Auto-advancing class: warm-up, two strength circuits, an abs/cardio finisher, and a full cooldown.
goal: General strength + conditioning for a general-athlete

phases.title: Warm-Up & Active Stretch
phases.description: Raise body temperature and mobilise hips, shoulders, and spine. Keep it easy and rhythmic.

items.cue: Sync breath: arch on inhale, round on exhale.
Slow and controlled; feel the hip open.
Small to big, control the speed.
Hinge at the hip, let momentum lead.
Squeeze the glutes at the top for 1s.
Glute-drive back out; keep the hips from rising.
Land soft; keep the heart-pump moderate.

phases.title: Circuit A · Main Muscle Groups
phases.description: Heavy multi-joint work for quads, chest, back, and glutes. Pick a challenging weight; the last 3 reps of every set should feel hard.

items.cue: Sit back, heels down, chest up; press through the whole foot.
Control the eccentric 2s; press up and out.
Flat back, pull to the hip, squeeze the shoulder blade.
Soft knees, long spine; feel the hamstrings stretch.

phases.title: Circuit B · Accessory & Isolation
phases.description: Lighter, higher-rep work to finish the shoulders, arms, and chest with good tempo and control.

items.cue: Lead with the elbows; stop below parallel, control the way down.
Brace the core; full range, straight line.
No swinging; 2s down, 1s up.
Elbows tucked; full overhead stretch without arching.

phases.title: Circuit C · Abs & Cardio
phases.description: High-intensity finisher. Max effort on the work intervals; full rest between rounds.

items.cue: Hips level, knees to the floor, quick feet.
Brace the body; pull to the hip, no twist.
Straight line; hold the top of each side.
Explode up, land soft, immediately turn over.

phases.title: Static Cooldown
phases.description: Long, slow, breath-focussed holds. No bouncing. Breathe deep and let the body wind down.

items.cue: Long spine, reach toward the toes, don't bounce.
Tuck the pelvis; foot gently to the glute.
Step back, slight chin lift, breathe into the chest.
Tuck the pelvis; feel the front of the hip open.
Sink the hips, long exhale, let the shoulders drop.
Lengthen the spine first, then rotate; breathe.
